game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before ember hounds spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read score. Display Pass when score ≥ 60; otherwise display Retry. Check below, equal to and above the boundary. This is an exercise cutoff, not the adaptation rule. Test dataset 10: {'score': 59}; {'score': 61}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 340 points of ash bricks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Sulfur Springs Rush
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
